Gurugram Company Fined for Marketing Stunt During Waterlogging

Gurugram police fined Cars24 company ₹50,000 for using a boat for marketing during severe waterlogging in the city. The company's head, Prachi, stated they were unaware of the waterlogging's severity and apologized. The company later sought forgiveness after initially claiming the challan was false. The incident occurred amidst significant waterlogging in Gurugram.
